note: NECO CRS round 5 (R36 top-up): Eve from Adam's rib; Abel's accepted offering; Methuselah's 969 years; Lot rescued; Jacob's twelve sons; Joseph's ornate robe; Joshua succeeding Moses; Gideon's fleece; Saul's donkeys; Absalom's hair; Solomon's foreign wives; Gehazi's greed; Jonah's worm; Haggai and Zechariah; Matthew at the customs booth; Peter and Andrew first called; the meek inheriting the earth; the Last Supper as Passover; Pilate's washed hands; Father, forgive them; Joseph of Arimathea; ascension from Olivet; Philip in Samaria; Philippians the prison letter; Psalm 119's lamp; Train up a child. Scanned against NECO rounds 1-4, WAEC CRS (all rounds) and the JAMB pool.
